units.title_zh: 命題作文結構＋一致性（essay structure & consistency）
units.can_do: 我能用開頭—主體—結尾的結構寫一篇短的命題作文，也能讓整篇的時態一致、人稱一致、主詞和動詞一致。
units.situation_group: 寫作：命題作文與一致性
units.subject: eng

claims.text: A short topic essay has three main parts: an introduction that tells the topic and your main point, a body that gives reasons and examples, and a conclusion that restates your main point. This is the basic beginning-middle-end shape of an essay.
claims.verification_ref: 短的命題作文有三個主要部分：點出題目與主要觀點的開頭、提供理由與例子的主體、重申主要觀點的結尾；這就是作文「開頭—主體—結尾」的基本結構；屬英語作文通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Keep the same tense through your writing unless the time really changes. If you are writing about something that happened in the past, keep all the verbs for that event in the past tense, such as 'went' and 'saw', not 'went' and 'see'.
claims.verification_ref: 除非時間真的改變，整篇要保持相同時態；寫過去發生的事，同一件事的動詞都要用過去式，例如 went 和 saw，而不是 went 配 see；屬英語語法一致性通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Keep the same person (point of view) for the same idea. If you begin writing about 'I', do not suddenly switch to 'you' or 'we' for the same idea.
claims.verification_ref: 同一個想法要保持相同人稱（視角）；開頭用「I」寫，就不要在同一個想法裡突然換成「you」或「we」；屬英語寫作一致性通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Make the verb agree with the subject. A singular subject takes a singular verb ('She walks.'), and a plural subject takes a plural verb ('They walk.'). In the present simple, a singular third-person subject usually takes a verb ending in -s.
claims.verification_ref: 動詞要和主詞一致：單數主詞配單數動詞（She walks.），複數主詞配複數動詞（They walk.）；一般現在式中，第三人稱單數主詞的動詞通常加 -s；屬英語主謂一致標準規則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: A short topic essay has three parts, like a beginning, a middle, and an end. The introduction comes first: it tells the topic and your main point. The body comes in the middle: it gives your reasons and examples, often one reason in each sentence or group of sentences. The conclusion comes last: it restates your main point in a new way. This clear shape helps the reader follow your writing.
teach.zh_hint: 短的命題作文有三個部分，就像開頭、中間、結尾。開頭在最前面：點出題目和你的主要觀點。主體在中間：提供你的理由和例子，常常一個理由寫一句或一小段。結尾在最後：用不同的說法重申你的主要觀點。這個清楚的結構能幫讀者跟上你的文章。

teach.body: Good writing is consistent in three ways. Tense: keep the same tense unless the time really changes; for a past event, use 'went' and 'saw', not 'went' and 'see'. Person: keep the same point of view for the same idea; if you start with 'I', do not switch to 'you' in the same idea. Subject and verb: make them agree, such as 'She walks' (singular) and 'They walk' (plural).
teach.zh_hint: 好的文章在三方面要一致。時態：除非時間真的改變，否則保持相同時態；寫過去的事用 went 和 saw，不要 went 配 see。人稱：同一個想法保持相同視角；開頭用 I，就不要在同一想法裡換成 you。主謂：主詞和動詞要一致，例如 She walks（單數）、They walk（複數）。

teach.body: Model outline for the topic 'My favorite season': Introduction — 'My favorite season is summer because I love the warm weather.' Body — 'First, I can swim at the beach because the water is warm. Also, the days are long, so I have more time to play.' Conclusion — 'For these reasons, summer is the best season because it is so fun.' Notice every verb stays in the present tense, and the writer stays with 'I' all the way through.
teach.zh_hint: 以「My favorite season」為題的範例大綱：開頭——'My favorite season is summer because I love the warm weather.'；主體——'First, I can swim at the beach because the water is warm. Also, the days are long, so I have more time to play.'；結尾——'For these reasons, summer is the best season because it is so fun.'。注意每個動詞都保持現在式，而且整篇都用「I」。

teach.body: Your turn: write one introduction sentence for the topic 'My favorite food'. It should name the topic and give your main point (your opinion). Example answers: My favorite food is noodles because they are warm and tasty. / I think pizza is the best food of all.
teach.zh_hint: 換你做：為題目「My favorite food」寫一句開頭句。要點出題目、並給出你的主要觀點（你的看法）。對照範例自評（不自動批改）：有點出題目＋表達你的看法即可（用字可不同）。範例：My favorite food is noodles because they are warm and tasty.／I think pizza is the best food of all.。

teach.body: Your turn: rewrite this line so the tense is consistent (make it all past tense) — 'Last weekend I visit my grandma and eat lunch with her.' Example answer: Last weekend I visited my grandma and ate lunch with her.
teach.zh_hint: 換你做：把這一行改成時態一致（整句都用過去式）——'Last weekend I visit my grandma and eat lunch with her.'。對照範例自評（不自動批改）：visit→visited、eat→ate，兩個動詞都變過去式才一致。正解：Last weekend I visited my grandma and ate lunch with her.。

practice.stem: 寫一篇題目是「My favorite season」的短作文，下面哪一句最適合放在『開頭』（點出題目＋你的主要觀點）？
practice.answer: My favorite season is summer because I love the warm weather.
options: My favorite season is summer because I love the warm weather.
First, I can swim at the beach because the water is warm.
For these reasons, summer is the best season because it is so fun.
The water was cold that day, so we went home early.

distractor_rationales.First, I can swim at the beach because t: 這是主體裡用 'First,' 帶出的一個理由，放在中間，不是開頭。
distractor_rationales.For these reasons, summer is the best se: 這是結尾句（重申主要觀點），放在最後，不是開頭。
distractor_rationales.The water was cold that day, so we went: 這是一個離題又跳到過去式的小細節，不適合當點出主要觀點的開頭。

practice.feedback: 開頭要點出題目＋你的主要觀點：'My favorite season is summer because I love the warm weather.' 正好說出題目（season）和你的看法（summer＋理由）。

practice.stem: 下面哪一句『時態前後一致』（整句都在講過去發生的事）？
practice.answer: Yesterday I went to the zoo and saw a tiger.
options: Yesterday I went to the zoo and saw a tiger.
Yesterday I go to the zoo and saw a tiger.
Yesterday I went to the zoo and see a tiger.
Yesterday I go to the zoo and see a tiger.

distractor_rationales.Yesterday I go to the zoo and saw a tige: go 是現在式、saw 是過去式，同一件過去的事時態不一致。
distractor_rationales.Yesterday I went to the zoo and see a ti: went 是過去式、see 是現在式，同一件過去的事時態不一致。
distractor_rationales.Yesterday I go to the zoo and see a tige: 兩個動詞都是現在式，但 'Yesterday'（昨天）是過去，應該用過去式。

practice.feedback: 'Yesterday' 是過去，兩個動詞都要用過去式才一致：went 和 saw——'Yesterday I went to the zoo and saw a tiger.'。

practice.stem: 下面哪一句的『主詞和動詞一致』（agree）？
practice.answer: The two boys play soccer every day.
options: The two boys play soccer every day.
The two boys plays soccer every day.
My brother play soccer every day.

主詞 'The two boys' 是複數，動詞不該加 -s，應該用 play。
主詞 'My brother' 是第三人稱單數，動詞應該用 plays。
主詞 'She' 是第三人稱單數，動詞應該用 plays。

practice.feedback: 複數主詞 'The two boys' 配複數動詞 play：'The two boys play soccer every day.' 主謂一致。

practice.stem: 下面哪一句『人稱前後一致』（同一個想法從頭到尾用同一個人稱）？
practice.answer: When I feel tired, I take a short rest.
options: When I feel tired, I take a short rest.
When I feel tired, you take a short rest.
When you feel tired, I take a short rest.
When I feel tired, we take a short rest.

distractor_rationales.When I feel tired, you take a short rest: 前半用 'I'、後半突然換成 'you'，同一個想法裡人稱跳掉了。
distractor_rationales.When you feel tired, I take a short rest: 前半用 'you'、後半換成 'I'，同一個想法裡人稱不一致。
前半用 'I'、後半換成 'we'，同一個想法裡人稱不一致。

practice.feedback: 同一個想法從頭到尾都用 'I' 才一致：'When I feel tired, I take a short rest.'。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案／範例自己判斷（不自動批改手寫作答）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 朗讀檢查（不產音檔、不自動判讀）：把你寫好的作文出聲讀一遍，一邊讀一邊檢查『有沒有開頭—主體—結尾』『時態、人稱、主謂有沒有前後一致』。

lines.text: My favorite season is summer because I love the warm weather.
Last weekend I visited my grandma and ate lunch with her.
